scope: Targeted authoring notes for six draft candidates. Not an exhaustive search, systematic review, safety certification, rights clearance or publication decision. Original catalog and generation fingerprints are retained unchanged.

sourceChecks.summary: The WHO overview addresses responsive care and early learning in the first three years, within wider caregiver support. It does not validate an app script.
sourceChecks.limitation: The full guideline download timed out; NCBI's alternative returned a browser check. Recommendation evidence tables and full applicability remain unappraised in this pass.
sourceChecks.nextReview: Read the full guideline and relevant evidence tables; assess transfer from supported programmes to these parent-only micro-invitations.

sourceChecks.locator: Physical PDF pages 6–10 (printed pages 2–7), extracted text, including the embedded counselling card
sourceChecks.summary: The manual situates play and communication in caregiver counselling and practice. It includes age-group examples and coaching; MIRA is not delivering that complete service.
sourceChecks.limitation: Only selected sections read, not the full manual, clinical practice package or outcome evidence. Historical object/positioning/eye-contact examples were not adopted as app safety rules.
sourceChecks.nextReview: Review the complete relevant manual and counselling context, accessible alternatives and adaptation rights. Do not infer that a household item or activity is safe from the source's general wording.

sourceChecks.locator: Both PDF pages, steps 1–5 and explanatory text
sourceChecks.summary: The handout describes noticing a child's contribution, responding, allowing time and recognising endings. It is a practice explanation, not an evaluation of MIRA.
sourceChecks.limitation: No source-derived age cutoff, exchange quota, clinical instruction or app-specific outcome is established. Underlying studies and FIND coaching are not independently appraised here.
sourceChecks.nextReview: Check accessibility and the distinction between a practice explanation and intervention evidence. Resolve reuse/attribution rights before any handout adaptation.

sourceChecks.locator: Abstract, moderator results, Discussion and limitations
sourceChecks.summary: The synthesis covers 102 interventions in 33 countries during the first three years. Programme outcomes cannot establish the efficacy of an isolated MIRA invitation.
sourceChecks.limitation: Unexplained heterogeneity, variable measures, incomplete implementation reporting and multiple comparisons constrain transfer. Preschool-only interventions were outside its scope; it is not evidence for the 36–83-month candidate.
sourceChecks.nextReview: Appraise risk of bias, component/delivery differences and relevant original trials; avoid extracting an activity dose or a per-child prediction from pooled results.

sourceChecks.summary: The framework situates early learning within a supportive care environment. It supplies context, not a prescription for a daily activity schedule.
sourceChecks.limitation: Full framework appraisal remains pending. Economic returns and population-level claims are not used as promises to a family.
sourceChecks.nextReview: Read the full relevant framework and assess the bounded family-fit claim; check rights independently.

sourceChecks.locator: Principles 4–8, especially individual/context variation, agency and integrated subject opportunities
sourceChecks.summary: The professional statement emphasises context, individual variation and child agency. It supports considering those factors rather than treating age bands as fixed performance stages.
sourceChecks.limitation: This is professional guidance, not a trial of the comparison candidate. Underlying references, home transfer, the exact proposed age range and communication access need independent appraisal.
sourceChecks.nextReview: Review the proposed 36–83-month range and content across that span; narrow, split or reject it if appropriate. Do not infer readiness from chronological age alone.

sourceChecks.locator: Prior catalog notes from 2026-10-01; direct DOI retry on 2026-10-02
sourceChecks.summary: The prior catalog records a heterogeneous guided-play synthesis, not support for universally superior outcomes or this activity.
sourceChecks.limitation: Current DOI retrieval failed. No fresh full-text or supplement appraisal is claimed in this pass. The comparison candidate has no activity-specific efficacy evidence.
sourceChecks.nextReview: Obtain the article and supplements; assess risk of bias, populations, outcomes, comparators and relevance of the actual guided-play interventions.

editorialProposals.ages: Each JSON contains a proposed, unapproved age range for independent review. Numerical coverage across 0–83 months is not reviewed coverage or a balanced library.
editorialProposals.minutes: One to three minutes are author planning estimates, not evidence-based doses, minimum participation or timers.
editorialProposals.contextValidity: One-day context validity is an authoring proposal requiring review; answers must reflect the offered setting. It is not a scientifically established freshness interval.
editorialProposals.language: English wording only. A caregiver's comfortable interaction language is not a reviewed translation or proof of 30–40-language support.
editorialProposals.noObjects: These first candidates intentionally introduce no objects. They do not cover the product's full movement, making, book, music or exploration needs.
editorialProposals.authorship: AI-assisted editorial rewrites of the recorded Nebius invitations, not a new Nebius generation. No runtime provider call or credit use was needed.
editorialProposals.rights: Original short summaries and original MIRA draft wording only. No source illustrations, tables, training worksheets or story excerpts copied. Independent rights/attribution assessment remains pending.
editorialProposals.pending: Independent content/safety/accessibility/source review, verified reviewer identity and separately authorized editor publication. No reviewer is invented, no response is marked acceptable.
